hints.title: Row by Row Merge
hints.text: Merge rows one by one. After merging each row, keep only the k smallest partial sums.

hints.title: Pair Sums with Next Row
hints.text: When merging current list of at most k sums with the next row, compute all possible sums and retain only the k smallest.

hints.title: Final Kth Sum
hints.text: After processing all rows, the answer is the kth smallest sum in the accumulated list (1-indexed, so index k - 1).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all C^R combinations is astronomical for R, C <= 40.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pruning to only the k smallest sums after each row merge bounds space to O(K) and time to O(R * K * C * log(K)).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate merges rows sequentially, retaining only the top k candidates at each step.

solutions.approach: sequential row sum merging with top k pruning
